type At<O, P extends keyof O> = O[P];
type Value<O, P extends O> = P;
type Keys<O, P extends keyof O | 'fallback'> = P;
type StrictKeys<O, P extends keyof O & string> = P;
type RecordKeys<O, P extends Record<keyof O, number>> = P;
type MappingKeys<O, P extends Uppercase<keyof O & string>> = P;
type Shape<O, P extends {value: O}> = P;
type TestRecord<T,K extends keyof T> = T[K] extends {key:'x'} ? RecordKeys<T[K],{key:number}> : never;
type TestMapping<T,K extends keyof T> = T[K] extends {key:'x'} ? MappingKeys<T[K],'KEY'> : never;
type InvalidValue<T,K extends keyof T> = T[K] extends {key:'x'} ? Value<T[K],{key:'x'}> : never;
type InvalidShape<T,K extends keyof T> = T[K] extends {key:'x'} ? Shape<T[K],{value:{key:'x'}}> : never;
type InvalidSameParameter<T> = T extends {key:'x'} ? Value<T,{key:'x'}> : never;
type InvalidKey<T,K extends keyof T> = T[K] extends {key:'x'} ? At<T[K],'no'> : never;
type InvalidUnion<T,K extends keyof T> = T[K] extends {key:'x'} ? Keys<T[K],'key' | 'no'> : never;
type InvalidIntersection<T,K extends keyof T> = T[K] extends {key:'x'} ? StrictKeys<T[K],'no'> : never;
type Unselected<T,K extends keyof T> = T[K] extends {key:'x'} ? never : At<T[K],'key'>;
type Mapping<T extends string, X extends Uppercase<T>> = X;
type Letter<T,K extends keyof T> = T[K] extends {key:'x'} ? Mapping<T[K]['key'],'X'> : never;
